## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a2a66881e2eabe07c1fd3f1e2c09009cfb34f5a2`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- The delta `bd718b653a..a2a66881e2` is one commit, one line: the `description:` frontmatter of `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` (`joins` → `expand`).
- Carried forward from the at-tier review of `bd718b653a`: the page body from line 6 on is byte-identical, so every TRUE judgment on the rewritten "Filtering Across Relationships" section stands. That review covered:
  - the served nested form, one level and forward only (`engine.ts:11268-11331`, `relation-filter-lowering.ts:162-219`);
  - the 1000-id cap `INVALID_FILTER`/400 and the `PERMISSION_DENIED`/403 path;
  - the six verbs and two REST doors;
  - the second-level `INVALID_FILTER` refusal;
  - the reverse direction `INVALID_FIELD` on REST;
  - the dotted-path `INVALID_FIELD` at the engine and over REST;
  - the aggregation `filter`/`having` refusal;
  - the two passages quoted verbatim from PR #20902.
- New description sentence: TRUE. `expand` is a live `QuerySchema` key (`query.zod.ts:612`) and page §4 "Relationships (Expand)" (`:781`). Filtering (`:522`, §2), aggregations (`:565`, §5) and sorting (`:552`, §3) are live. `joins` stays tombstoned (`query.zod.ts:562`).
- The PR merges cleanly against `origin/main` `cf684c98eb` (`merge-tree` tree `e385f89b71`).

### ② Semver level

Docs only, one `content/docs/**` file; no changeset; `Clause-②: no`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The shared wording with the unmerged PR #20902 is verbatim today; whichever PR lands second re-quotes if the text moves.
- `check:skill-examples` is unmeasured (exit 3). It checks `<!-- os:check -->` fences only, and the diff adds none.
